deepak_tijori.bio: Deepak Tijori is an award-winning Indian actor, writer, and filmmaker whose body of work both in front of and behind the camera has left an indelible mark on Indian cinema and is increasingly resonating on the international stage. With a career spanning over three decades, he has become a respected name in global film circles, known for emotionally charged performances and bold, genre-defining storytelling. He first gained prominence through iconic roles in Bollywood classics such as Aashiqui (1990), Khiladi (1992), Jo Jeeta Wohi Sikandar (1992), Kabhi Haan Kabhi Naa (1994), Anjaam (1994), Ghulam (1998), and Baadshah (1999).

anita_sharma.name: Anita Sharma
anita_sharma.role: Music Department, Director, Producer (Co-Producer of Tipppsy); singer and live performer
anita_sharma.bio: Anita Sharma is an Indian creative professional whose work spans film production, music direction, and live performance. Based in Mumbai, she has been actively associated with the Indian entertainment industry through her work in cinema and music. Anita was Co-Producer of the Bollywood feature film 'Tipppsy' directed by Deepak Tijori. Following Tipppsy, she has begun exploring new avenues as an independent producer with the vision of developing and supporting new film and music projects. She has also stepped into the role of Music Video Director, directing a music video produced under the music label Tijori Music. Born in Mumbai and raised in Jamnagar, Gujarat, she developed her passion for music during her teenage years. Her energetic stage presence made her a widely recognized live performer during the Navratri festival circuit, where audiences fondly refer to her as the 'Gujarati Shakira.' She has performed across international stages and attends global festivals including Cannes.

mandeep_kaur_tijori.name: Mandeep Kaur Sandhu (Mandeep Kaur Tijori)
mandeep_kaur_tijori.role: Producer / Actor / Director - Alliance Productions India LLP
mandeep_kaur_tijori.bio: Mandeep Kaur Sandhu is an emerging film producer and actor actively engaged in internationally positioned cinema. As Director of Alliance Productions India LLP, she is involved in the development, packaging, and strategic production of both Indian and global feature films. Her current slate includes the production of a Hindi-language feature under Alliance Productions, alongside the development and international packaging of a biographical sports feature based on the life of a globally recognized footballer. The project is structured for cross-border collaboration and international market positioning, with formal announcements to follow. Mandeep's producing approach emphasizes performance-driven storytelling, culturally resonant narratives, and projects designed for strategic market engagement.
